shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating menus and dialogs; ordinary workspace surfaces stay flat.

motion.name: file-row-hover
motion.purpose: File row hover feedback; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

motion.name: sidebar-transition
motion.purpose: Sidebar width and menu transitions; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default shared button for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: var(--control-height); padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: var(--weight-control) var(--type-ui) var(--font-ui); white-space: nowrap; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-button-primary { min-height: var(--control-height-touch); } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Reversible or lower-emphasis action beside a primary control.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: var(--control-height); padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: var(--weight-control) var(--type-ui) var(--font-ui); white-space: nowrap; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-button-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-button-outline { min-height: var(--control-height-touch); } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Shared text field for search, account and settings forms.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: var(--input-height); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: var(--weight-body) var(--type-ui) var(--font-ui); transition: color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-input { min-height: var(--control-height-touch); } }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Current destination in the sidebar navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0.5rem; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font: var(--weight-control) var(--type-ui) var(--font-ui); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:active { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sidebar-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: File Row
components.description: Flat file listing row with aligned name, size and action columns.
components.html: Project notes.pdf248 KB
components.css: .ds-file-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 116px 44px; align-items: center; column-gap: 1rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 7px 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); font: var(--weight-body) var(--type-ui) var(--font-ui); transition: background 140ms ease-out; } .ds-file-row:hover, .ds-file-row:focus-within { background: var(--muted); } .ds-file-row small { color: var(--muted-foreground); text-align: right; font-size: var(--type-meta); } .ds-row-action { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-row-action:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-file-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 44px; gap: 8px; } .ds-file-row small { display: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-file-row { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: Sylux is a quiet file workspace. Keep its own system sans-serif type, green-gray surfaces and teal actions. Files and account tasks take priority over decoration.
